notes: The report gives only aggregate DRC figures (3605 confirmed cases, 1587 deaths, 651 recovered; 151 health-worker infections, 44 deaths, 68 recoveries; 1481 new confirmed cases since 17 July). It contains no individual case records with confirmation dates, onset dates, settings or descriptions, so no new_cases records were created. The 1481 new cases are not itemised. contacts_under_follow_up uses the 13,455 contacts 'under active follow-up'; the report also states 17,863 contacts 'identified and under follow-up'. suspected_cases is not stated for DRC. The 3605 DRC total includes two cases diagnosed in DRC and treated in Germany; the France and Uganda cases are excluded as non-DRC cases. The report was issued 1 August 2026 (citable reference), with a corrigendum on 3 August that does not change DRC figures.
